title: Continuous Canary Advisor: compile-time policy recommendations and runtime safety advisor for staged model rollouts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a Continuous Canary Advisor service that compiles a human-friendly canary rollout config into an enforceable runtime policy plus automatic safety checks. The advisor combines static validation (DSL/type checks, incompatible settings), heuristic recommendations (step sizing, cooldown, cohort proportions) and runtime guardrails (SLO gating, surge smoothing, shadow probing). Goal is to reduce failed rollouts and manual tuning for model ingestion teams.
motivation: Teams are frequently misconfiguring staged rollouts (too-aggressive splits, no cooldowns, missing shadow probes) leading to customer-visible regressions or wasted cost. We want a system that (1) flags risky configs early, (2) suggests safer defaults tied to observed traffic kinetics and SLOs, and (3) produces runtime policies that can be audited and enforced across Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor accepts legacy canary DSL and new YAML schema and returns: (a) compiled runtime policy JSON, (b) list of warnings/errors, (c) human-readable recommendations
Advisor enforces at runtime: SLO gating for latency and error rate, cooldown timers between steps, automatic rollback when thresholds breached
Built-in suggestions for step schedules based on traffic volume: e.g., min-cohort-size enforcement and burst-smoothing policy
Console displays advisor warnings and recommendations in rollout UI; PR hooks show advisor report on model rollout PRs
Integration tests covering: gradual step progression, rollback on sustained SLA breach, shadow probe detection and probe-fallthrough logging
tasks: Draft advisor schema extension (YAML) and mapping to runtime policy primitives
Implement static linter rules (type compatibility, incompatible options, min-cohort-size checks)
Implement suggestion heuristics: traffic-aware step sizing, sigmoid ramp option, cooldown calculators
Runtime enforcement: implement SLO gate operator, cooldown state machine, rollback triggers and audit events
Add shadow-probe orchestration: configurable shadow fraction + probe validation windows
Integrate advisor into Console: show warnings, allow override with justification, attach compiled policy to rollout record
Write unit and e2e tests; add telemetry for advisor recommendations and rollout outcomes
telemetry_signals: token error-rate and application error-rate mapped to request metadata
shadow-probe success ratio and divergence metric vs baseline
step progression times and cooldown expirations
runtime_policy_examples: Example 1: conservative sigmoid-ramp: 0% -> 5% in 10m (linear), 5% -> 50% over 2h (sigmoid), cooldown 30m between steps; SLO gate: p95 latency increase < 15% and error-rate delta < 0.2%
Example 2: volume-aware min-cohort: require at least 50000 tokens in cohort or hold at current split; automatic shadow probe (2% traffic) for 1h before opening the first split
Example 3: surge-smoothing: when incoming request rate increases > 40% over baseline, freeze progression and reduce target split by 50% until rate normalizes
decision_log: 2026-03-03: Chose to extend existing YAML DSL instead of creating a separate CRD to minimize migration effort (Maya, Ravi)
2026-03-04: Use p95 latency and token-error-rate as primary SLO signals; secondary SLOs will include request timeout rate (Sofia approved)
2026-03-06: Rollout advisor will produce both 'recommendation' and 'enforceable_policy' artifacts; Console shows recommendation but can attach enforceable policy with owner approval
implementation_notes: Static linter will run as part of model-version PR checks and on save in Console
Runtime policy compiled to JSON with explicit primitives: {split_schedule, cooldowns, slo_gates, shadow_probes, rollback_actions}
We will reuse existing SLO evaluation pipelines for gate checks; need small adapter to map model-version to SLO stream
For Private deployments, advisor will run as an offline compiler and deliver artifacts via Sigstore-signed bundle
Feature flag: advisor.opt_in_for_strict_enforcement for first 4 weeks to gather feedback
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Advisor recommendations are ignored by teams leading to inconsistent safety coverage. Mitigation: Console will show warnings prominently and require override with rationale for critical warnings
Risk: Overly conservative defaults slow rollouts. Mitigation: we will expose confidence bands and allow product owners to select aggression tier; collect outcome metrics to refine heuristics
Risk: False-positive rollbacks due to noisy telemetry. Mitigation: require sustained SLO breach for configurable window (default 10 minutes) and apply smoothing on metrics
